name: Road repair priority
method: Priority score 0 to 100: the weighted mean of Condition 50% (higher values raise the priority, rescaled between 1 and 5); Road type 20% (higher values raise the priority, rescaled between 0 and 100); Near a school or hospital 15% (lower values raise the priority, rescaled between 0 and 600); Surface age 15% (higher values raise the priority, rescaled between its 5th and 95th percentile). Classes: Very low, Low, Medium, High, Very high at breaks 20, 40, 60, 80. Dates counted to 2026-11-24. A prioritisation aid from the criteria and weights stated, not an engineering or condition assessment. Condition ratings are as their publisher or inspector recorded them.
